scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the Children of the Registered Worker Studying in 11th and 12th Standard
other_conditions: Child or wife must be studying in 11th or 12th standard
Only children and spouse of workers registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board are eligible
Benefit applies to a maximum of two children per worker and to the wife of a registered male worker
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year for up to two children and the wife of a registered construction worker studying in 11th or 12th standard.
